stem:
He has affected to render the Military independent of and superior to the Civil power.

—Declaration of Independence

How was this grievance addressed by the Founding Fathers?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: By making the president the commander in chief of the armed forces

options.label: G
options.text: By requiring the president and members of Congress to take the oath of office

options.label: H
options.text: By giving the president and Congress the power to make treaties

options.label: J
options.text: By giving Congress the power to draft civilians into the armed forces

visual_elements: text box containing the quote from Declaration of Independence
